Les îles Whitsunday, au large du Queensl: The Whitsunday Islands, off the coast of Queensland, are best discovered by boat. We left from Airlie Beach, the town most cruises depart from, on board a sailing boat run by Matador, for two days and one night at sea.

Les repas sont compris : le déjeuner et: Meals are included: lunch and dinner on Saturday, then breakfast and lunch on Sunday. You do not need to bring anything to eat on board.
<b>Le matériel de snorkeling est compris: Snorkelling gear is included, wetsuit too, and we had nothing extra to pay on the spot.
Pas de boissons particulières incluses e: No special drinks are included on top of the meals, but you can bring your own food and drinks on board.
<b>Whitehaven Beach.</b> Premier grand a: Whitehaven Beach. The first big stop, and we climbed up to the Hill Inlet lookout to see what is often called the most beautiful beach in the world. Unfortunately, the weather was not on our side that day: be ready for it to work against you, that is the lottery of every cruise.
Les tourbillons de sable blanc de Hill I: The swirls of white sand at Hill Inlet seen from above, at the end of Whitehaven Beach
<b>Trois spots de snorkeling sur la Gran: Three snorkelling spots on the Great Barrier Reef, one after another on Sunday morning. This is the heart of the cruise: we saw a Napoleon wrasse, turtles and a huge amount of coral. They are among the most beautiful snorkelling spots I have ever done, and one of the most memorable moments of my road trip. We had a wetsuit to get in the water. In October, the jellyfish in the Whitsundays are not dangerous, but check with the crew if you go at another time of year.
<b>La soirée du samedi</b> n'a rien d'ex: Saturday evening is nothing special: a bit of music on deck, time to get to know each other, and everyone goes to bed fairly early. It is very simple, and that is also the charm of a night at sea.
On était un groupe d'une vingtaine de pa: We were a group of about twenty passengers, with three or four crew members. The atmosphere is friendly, and it is easy to get to know people when you share the same deck for two days.

Le dimanche, réveil tous ensemble, puis: On Sunday, everyone wakes up together, then the morning of snorkelling before heading back to Airlie Beach.
<b>Les repas</b> sont de bonne qualité,: The meals are good quality, but simple. Do not expect fine dining, rather generous, well made dishes for a day at sea.

Pour obtenir un deuxième Working Holiday: To get a second Working Holiday visa, you need to have done three months of specified work during the first one. For a third visa, six months during the second.
Tout le monde parle des 88 jours, l'immi: Everyone talks about the 88 days, immigration talks about three months. It is the same thing, but the official text is what decides in case of a dispute.
Une condition traverse tout le dispositi: One condition runs through the whole scheme: the work must be paid in line with the law and the industry award. A job paid in cash below the legal minimum does not count, even if you really did it.
La seule exception au travail rémunéré c: The only exception to paid work is volunteering linked to rebuilding after a bushfire or a declared natural disaster.
La liste officielle est publiée sur la p: The official list is published on the immigration Specified work page, and it is the one that counts.
Au moment où j'écris, elle couvre la cul: At the time of writing, it covers plant and animal cultivation in regional areas, fishing and pearling, tree farming and felling, mining, construction, tourism and hospitality in the north and very remote areas, as well as recovery work after a bushfire or a declared natural disaster.
Attention à une distinction qui piège be: Watch out for a distinction that catches a lot of people out: secondary processing does not count. Picking grapes counts, making wine does not. Raising animals counts, making cured meat does not. Retail does not either.
L'immigration applique par ailleurs une: Immigration also applies a temporary flexibility: work that supports an eligible industry, for example admin or cleaning, may be accepted if it takes place in an eligible postcode. This flexibility can disappear, which is why you should check the official page when you sign.
Le secteur ne suffit pas, le lieu compte: The industry is not enough, the place matters just as much. Immigration thinks in postcodes, not town names.
Trois catégories se superposent : l'Aust: Three categories overlap: regional Australia, northern Australia, and the so called remote and very remote areas. Depending on your industry, a different category applies. Tourism and hospitality only count in the north and very remote areas, whereas agriculture counts across all of regional Australia.
La méthode fiable tient en une phrase :: The reliable method fits in one sentence: take the exact postcode of the farm or business, not the nearest town's, and check it on the official page before you accept the job.
Le compteur suit les jours travaillés, p: The counter follows the days worked, not the days spent there. A part time week is not worth a full week.
Les jours n'ont pas besoin d'être conséc: The days do not have to be consecutive. You can add them up with several employers, in several regions, at different times of the year.
Le travail à la tâche, payé au poids ou: Piece rate work, paid by weight or by the bin, is converted into days according to precise rules. It is the most misunderstood and most disputed case, so check the official page before accepting that way of being paid.
C'est à toi de prouver ton travail spéci: It is up to you to prove your specified work, not your employer. An incomplete file, and the three months do not count.
Conserve toutes les fiches de paie, les: Keep every payslip, the bank statements showing the salary transfers, your tax file number linked to each employer, and the full contact details of the farms and businesses.
L'immigration met à disposition un formu: Immigration provides a declaration form for the employer to fill in. Get it signed at the end of each job, not six months later when the farm no longer answers the phone.
Being paid in cash with no payslip. Very common on farms, and fatal for your application.
Travailler sous un ABN quand le poste re: Working under an ABN when the job is really employment. Some employers ask for it to avoid contributions. Those days can be challenged, and on top of that you miss out on superannuation.
Accepter un job dans le bon secteur mais: Taking a job in the right industry but in an ineligible postcode. A few kilometres are enough to cancel everything.
Payer pour obtenir un travail ou pour un: Paying to get a job or a place on a farm. Job scams are a classic in this world, and immigration will not validate those days either.
Faire confiance à un forum plutôt qu'à l: Trusting a forum rather than the official page. The rules have changed a lot in recent years, and half the advice going around is out of date.
